name: Cat Parts Store

platform.framework: IBM WebSphere Commerce / HCL Commerce (storeId=21801, catalogId=10051, langId=-1; *View servlets, SearchDisplay)
platform.bot_protection: Akamai edge — server-side/WebFetch reads to category pages timed out (>60s) in discovery; capture will need the browser-eval path. Possible dealer/store-selection gate before browse/pricing.

search.category_url_pattern: https://parts.cat.com/en/catcorp/category/<slug>  e.g. batteries-hvy-duty (26 results), ground-engaging-tools, get-bucket-teeth-adapter-sys, filters-and-fluids-filters; paginates with ?beginIndex=&pageSize= (16/page)
search.typeahead: Live autocomplete works as guest: 'Suggested Keywords' + 'Products' (part# + name). Note preview finding: 'heavy duty battery' typeahead surfaces dry-cell consumer batteries (1U-9539 9V, 1U-9538 AA-Cell) by name-match over the real Heavy Duty equipment battery line.
search_paradigms: part-number (7-char alphanumeric NNC-NNNN, e.g. 1R-1808, 326-1644, 1U3202) — the core lookup
serial-number → SIS parts books / 2D diagrams (drill to part numbers)
cross-reference / interchange (competitor part number → Cat part, esp. filters)
machine model + system (C15, 320, D6) — model-qualified part queries
category / duty-class browse (Heavy Duty, General Duty, Severe Duty)
search.capture: GUEST-ACCESSIBLE — no dealer gate (probed 2026-08-12). Store selection is optional and only drives pricing/availability, not browse/search. Real browser passes Akamai (homepage/category/search all render); server-side/WebFetch times out, so capture MUST use the browser-eval path. Product tiles render server-side as '<PART#>: <Description>' (e.g. '9X-3404: 12V Heavy Duty Maintenance-Free Battery') — part number IS the identity, no slug derivation needed. Filter out injected non-product tiles ('Reference Parts Diagram', 'Add Equipment' promos) that appear inline in the grid. Facets: two groups — Category (refinement links) and Specifications (dimensional, US/Metric toggle: Belt Type, Blade Width, Bolt Length, etc.).
search.notes: 1.4M+ parts. Catcorp = generic corporate store (dealer-agnostic). Categories confirmed via web: Attachments, Cabs, Drivetrain, Electrical & Electronics, Engine, Filters & Fluids, Ground Engaging Tools, Hardware/Seals/Consumables, Hoses & Tubes, Hydraulics, Structures & Other Systems, Undercarriage, Upgrade & Repair Kits, Workshop Supplies, Planned Maintenance Kits, Cat Reman, Batteries.

notes: parts.cat.com (Cat Parts Store, catcorp) — Caterpillar genuine heavy-equipment replacement parts. WebSphere/HCL Commerce behind Akamai. Heavy Duty sector. Part-number-heavy B2B demand: the category-recall method covers the category/duty-class head but cannot synthesize part-number/serial/cross-reference queries — surfacing that blind spot is a primary goal of running the first two skills here. Never bypass bot protection; recover by waiting for cooldown, never by rotating identities.
